ambient_events: A pylon wakes as something passes in the channel, reads nothing it recognises, and goes dark again.
The canopy's underside brightens by a degree as the light on the basin fails.
A hose withdraws into its pylon with a soft, expensive sound.
Water slaps the float and the deck does not move under it.
description: A broad floating deck on the north face of the marina, where the covered dock's channel opens onto the basin. A single blade of glass canopy on one mast, edged in Fairweather's champagne metal and lit from beneath. Under it, three slim chrome dispensing pylons, each with a screen that shows a price once a hull is alongside and recognised. A gangway runs west to the visitor pontoon.
name: Fairweather Marina — The Fuel Berth
